item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two dozen rabbits discovered abandoned at county park in Plant City
item.description: Hillsborough County Animal Control said county workers discovered two dozen rabbits abandoned at McIntosh Preserve on Knights Griffin Road in Plant City. The Humane Society of Tampa Bay is caring for the animals.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] How new heat meters protect student athletes in Hillsborough County sports complexes
item.description: Hillsborough County installed heat stress meters at local sports complexes to protect youth athletes from dangerous extreme temperatures during outdoor practices.
